text: We propose a novel framework for citation parsing. We trained a BiLSTM with AdamW on the PubMed corpus. Our results indicate that the model achieves an accuracy of 0.91 and an F1 of 87.5%. We assume that references are well formed. A limitation of this study is that only English papers were used. The Transformer outperforms the baseline on SQuAD (p < 0.01). Future work is needed to cover scanned documents.
